title: How to Get Hired With Zero Experience
description:
Most candidates with no experience think that's why they're not getting hired. It's not. 86% of interview rejections have nothing to do with your skills. Here's the exact 3-step system I use to get candidates with zero experience hired at companies like Citadel, JP Morgan, and more.

0:00 - John's Story (Zero Experience to Citadel)
1:12 - Why 86% of Rejections Aren't About Skills
1:46 - Step 1: Build Your Personal Brand Story
2:48 - The Golden Circle Framework
4:28 - Step 2: Replace Applications With Networking
5:56 - The LATR System (List, Ask, Track, Repeat)
7:35 - Step 3: Turn Non-Experience Into Real Experience
8:20 - The CV Formula That Gets 26% Conversion
9:08 - What to Do Next

If you're not getting interviews and you're ready to fix your job search, check out The Offer Accelerator. It's the step-by-step system I've built over 6 years of coaching candidates into roles they didn't think they could get. Link below.
